title: Eco-sensitive Zone Outer-Limit Context
alt: Map comparing the official 2020 Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve eco-sensitive-zone outer limit with indicative OpenStreetMap reserve reference outlines
summary: Maps the official outer-limit geometry supplied by the Rajasthan Forest Department for the 2020 MHTR eco-sensitive zone. The Gazette-notified ESZ covers 248.70 km²; the KML polygon is the larger outer envelope around the reserve and ESZ, not the ESZ band alone.
useFor: Use this to understand the outer extent of the notified 2020 ESZ and why its KML envelope area must not be reported as the ESZ area.
sources: MoEFCC Gazette S.O. 4268(E), 25 Nov 2020; Rajasthan Forest Department MHTR ESZ KML, as on 1 Jun 2026; OpenStreetMap reference outlines

title: Indicative Reserve and Landscape Context
alt: GIS orientation map showing indicative Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve and Bhainsrodgarh reference outlines, protected areas, rivers, roads and district context
summary: Shows broad MHTR landscape context using public OpenStreetMap reference geometry. The 5 October 2023 notification and updated Tiger Conservation Plan establish Bhainsrodgarh's core status; the displayed linework is not a legal boundary survey.
useFor: Use this first when explaining where MHTR sits in the wider Kota, Bundi, Chittaurgarh and Jhalawar landscape.
sources: Rajasthan Forest Department notification dated 5 Oct 2023, updated MHTR TCP, OpenStreetMap, geoBoundaries

title: Terrain and Ridge Relief
alt: Shaded relief terrain map of Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve showing ridges, valleys, water lines and indicative reserve reference outlines
summary: Uses DEM-derived shaded relief with metre-based elevation bands and high/low callouts to make the ridge-to-valley structure visible.
useFor: Use this to explain why slopes, valleys and long linear ridges shape habitat, visibility, patrol access and movement, with approximate elevation context.
sources: Mapzen/AWS Terrarium elevation tiles, OpenStreetMap, MHTR TCP

title: Water Systems and Hydrology
alt: Hydrology map of the Mukundara Hills landscape showing rivers, reservoirs, canals, roads, rail, settlements and indicative reserve reference outlines
summary: Highlights Chambal-linked rivers, reservoirs, canals and drainage lines around the reserve, with key public water-body names labelled.
useFor: Use this for dry-season stress, wetland value, riparian corridors and water-linked movement context.
sources: OpenStreetMap, Mapzen/AWS Terrarium elevation tiles, MHTR TCP

title: Elevation Zones and Contours
alt: Elevation-zone GIS map of Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve with DEM-derived bands, contours, waterways and indicative reserve reference outlines
summary: Classifies local elevation bands in metres, adds 50 m contours, and marks representative high-ridge and lower-valley points.
useFor: Use this when discussing high ridges, lower valleys, drainage floors and terrain-driven microhabitats with approximate DEM elevation values.
sources: Mapzen/AWS Terrarium elevation tiles, OpenStreetMap, MHTR TCP

title: Land-cover and Habitat Context
alt: ESA WorldCover land-cover map around Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve showing tree cover, grassland, shrubland, cropland, built-up area and water
summary: Uses ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 to show broad tree cover, shrubland, grassland, cropland, built-up area, bare ground and water. WorldCover ended with the 2021 reference year; this layer is therefore retained as a dated baseline, not described as current land cover.
useFor: Use this as a 2021 habitat baseline, then interpret later change and fine habitat details with dated satellite products, field notes and forest records.
sources: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, OpenStreetMap, MHTR TCP
